6077: local function GVEnsureKeystoneFeed()
6078:     if _gvRegistered then return end
6079:     local lib = GVLib()
6080:     if not lib then return end
6081:     _gvRegistered = true
6082:     -- Filtered on group membership, NOT the delivery channel: a group member who is
6083:     -- also a guildmate can have their reply arrive tagged GUILD, and dropping it
6084:     -- blanks their row. Membership is still required so a guild-wide reply burst cannot flood the cache with unshowable players.
6085:     lib.Register(_gvLibToken, function(keyLevel, keyMapID, _, playerName)
6086:         if not playerName or not GVInGroup(playerName) then return end
6087:         local e = _gvKeys[playerName]
6088:         if e then e.mapID, e.level = keyMapID, keyLevel
6089:         else _gvKeys[playerName] = { mapID = keyMapID, level = keyLevel } end
6090:         GVRepaintOpenTooltip()
6091:     end)
6092: end

6119: function GVInGroup(playerName)
6120:     if not IsInGroup() then return false end
6121:     local short = GVShortName(playerName)
6122:     if not short then return false end
6123:     local prefix, count = GVGroupRange()
6124:     for i = 1, count do
6125:         if GVShortName(GetUnitName(prefix .. i, true)) == short then return true end
6126:     end
6127:     return false
6128: end
